Plot locally available G-TROPIC data

Source: R/gtropic_plot.R
gtropic_plot.Rd

Creates exposure maps, exposure-count maps, and storm-track maps from tables already returned by gtropic_data(). Plotting never retrieves data or recalculates published exposure values and storm distances.

Usage

gtropic_plot(
  data,
  type = c("exposure", "count", "track"),
  metric = NULL,
  storm = NULL,
  adm2 = NULL,
  aggregate = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  binary = FALSE,
  count_unit = c("storms", "days"),
  facet_by = NULL,
  track = NULL,
  track_map_key = saffir_simpson(),
  track_labels = TRUE,
  track_interval = 6,
  track_legend_position = NULL,
  basemap = c("countries", "admin1", "none"),
  bbox = NULL,
  expand = 2,
  crs = NULL,
  interactive = FALSE,
  palette = NULL,
  direction = NULL,
  gridlines = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A gtropic_data object returned by gtropic_data(), or a uniquely named list of equivalent local tables. Data are never downloaded and published exposure values, distances, and tracks are not recalculated.

type

The output type. One of "exposure" (the default), "count", or "track". Exposure maps summarize the selected metric; count maps count observations meeting its exposure threshold; track maps draw storm positions.

metric

A supported published metric name, or a character vector of metric names for exposure or count maps. Its order determines panel, scale, and caption order. NULL selects the first available default: "VMAX_SUST_MS", "PRECIP_MM", or "PROP_FLOODED_POP" for exposure/count maps and "USA_WIND" for track maps. Track maps require exactly one of "USA_WIND" or "USA_STATUS".

storm

Optional character vector of storm IDs or names used to subset all applicable tables. Names require storm_metadata and are matched case-insensitively. NULL (the default) retains all storms.

adm2

Optional character vector of ADM2 IDs used to subset all applicable tables. NULL (the default) retains all ADM2 units. For a track map, this retains tracks linked to the selected ADM2 units when linkage data are present.

aggregate

Summary method for exposure maps: one of "max", "min", "sum", "mean", or "n". NULL (the default) uses the metric-specific published default. A single value is recycled over metric; multiple values must either be in metric order or be named for every selected metric. Count maps always use "n" and reject another value; this argument does not affect track maps.

threshold

A named list of finite numeric thresholds, with names matching selected metrics. NULL (the default) uses a built-in threshold where one is defined. Thresholds determine which observations are counted for type = "count" and which areas are classified for binary = TRUE; an explicit threshold is required when no default exists. It does not affect continuous exposure maps or track maps.

binary

Logical; if TRUE, show exposure/count maps as exposed or not exposed using threshold, rather than as a continuous value scale. Defaults to FALSE. It is not available for track maps.

count_unit

The unit counted by a count map: distinct qualifying "storms" (the default) or "days". It applies only when type = "count" and is otherwise ignored.

facet_by

An optional single column name in the assembled plotting data to use for facets. NULL (the default) adds no extra facet; multiple metrics always receive separate panels. The column must be available after matching and aggregation.

track

Whether to overlay tracks on exposure/count maps. NULL (the default) overlays them when data contains a tracks table; TRUE or FALSE explicitly enables or suppresses the overlay. Track maps always draw tracks regardless of this value.

track_map_key

A data frame defining wind categories for track points, with category, increasing threshold ceilings ending in Inf, one unit, and either color or colour. Defaults to saffir_simpson(). It controls USA_WIND track points and exposure/count track overlays, but not a USA_STATUS track map.

track_labels

Logical; if TRUE (the default), static maps label each storm with more than one valid observation at its first valid position when multiple storms are shown. It is ignored for interactive maps.

track_interval

Interval in UTC hours at which track intensity points are displayed: 3 or 6 (the default). Paths always retain every observation. NULL displays every point. It affects track maps and enabled track overlays.

track_legend_position

Position of per-panel metric scale strips on static exposure/count maps. NULL (the default) places horizontal strips below the panels. "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "top left", "top right", "bottom left", and "bottom right" place them in each panel. It is ignored for track and interactive maps.

basemap

Installed Natural Earth layer: "countries" (the default), "admin1", or "none". No layer is downloaded. "admin1" requires the optional rnaturalearthhires package.

bbox

Map extent as an sf/sfc object, an sf bbox with a known CRS, or geographic c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax). NULL (the default) derives the extent from the plotted geometry and any displayed tracks.

expand

Nonnegative geographic-degree padding added to each side of the map extent after bbox is resolved. Defaults to 2.

crs

A coordinate reference system understood by sf::st_crs(). NULL (the default) selects EPSG:4326 for longitudinal spans under 40 degrees and Equal Earth for wider extents. Static maps use this projection; interactive Leaflet maps are always rendered in geographic coordinates.

interactive

Logical; if TRUE, return an offline Leaflet exposure or count map instead of a ggplot. Defaults to FALSE; track maps cannot be interactive.

palette

Viridis palette name or letter, or a vector of them. NULL (the default) uses metric-specific palettes. One value is recycled over metric; multiple values must be in metric order or named for every metric. It applies to exposure/count fills and a USA_STATUS track map, but is ignored for categorical USA_WIND track points controlled by track_map_key.

direction

Palette direction: 1 (the default) or -1. It accepts the same scalar, positional, and named forms as palette, and applies in the same situations.

gridlines

Logical; if TRUE (the default), static maps show gridlines and longitude/latitude labels. It is ignored for Leaflet maps, which have no static axes.

title, subtitle, caption

Plot labels. Each defaults to NULL, which uses an automatic title/subtitle/caption. A supplied caption replaces the automatic provenance and method caption.

quiet

Logical; if FALSE (the default), report data-preparation progress.

...

Named arguments passed to ggplot2::geom_sf() for static exposure or count polygons, or to leaflet::addPolygons() for interactive polygons. Track plots accept no additional arguments.

Value

A ggplot for static output or a leaflet widget for interactive output.

Details

Maps use the actual date range of contributing observations after storm, ADM2, and linkage filters. Metric panels use readable metric names. Automatic captions report the applicable radii, windows, aggregations, track interval, and plotting CRS in metric order.

Track paths are drawn from every supplied observation. By default, constant- size points use saffir_simpson() categories derived from USA_WIND, which is published in knots and converted to the map key's unit before classification. An explicit metric = "USA_STATUS" retains the status-colour display.
